title: sql-http-proxy configuration
description: Configuration file schema for sql-http-proxy. Define HTTP endpoints that map to SQL queries or mock data.

global_helpers.title: Global Helpers

oneOf.title: Inline JavaScript (string)
oneOf.description: Inline JavaScript helpers (shorthand for global_helpers.js)

oneOf.title: JavaScript Files (object)

js.title: Inline JavaScript
examples: function validate(x) { if (!x) throw { status: 400, body: { error: 'required' } }; return x; }

js_files.title: JavaScript File Paths
js_files.description: Paths to JavaScript helper files (relative to config file)

oneOf.description: Object form with js and/or js_files

global_helpers.description: Global JavaScript helpers available in all JS contexts (pre, post, mock JS, filter, csv.value_parser)

csv.title: CSV Config

value_parser.title: CSV Value Parser
value_parser.description: JavaScript code to parse each CSV cell value. Receives 'value' (string). Should return the parsed value.

csv.description: Global CSV parsing configuration for mock csv and csv_file sources

dsn.title: DSN (Data Source Name)
dsn.description: Database connection string. Supports ${VAR}, $VAR, ${VAR:-default} environment variable expansion. Required unless all endpoints use mock data.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: List of query endpoints for SELECT operations. Each query maps an HTTP path to a SQL SELECT or mock data.

mutations.title: Mutations
mutations.description: List of mutation endpoints for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations. Each mutation maps an HTTP path to a SQL statement or mock data.

path.title: Endpoint Path
path.description: HTTP endpoint path. Must start with /.

sql.title: SQL Query
sql.description: SQL query or statement with named placeholders using :name syntax. Placeholders are replaced with request parameters.
examples: SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = :status ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit
INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES (:name, :email) RETURNING *
UPDATE users SET name = :name WHERE id = :id RETURNING *

method.title: HTTP Method (Mutation)
method.description: HTTP method for mutation endpoint. POST: create, PUT: replace, PATCH: partial update, DELETE: delete.

queryMethod.title: HTTP Method (Query)
queryMethod.description: HTTP method for query endpoint. GET is default. Use POST for complex parameters in request body.

accepts.title: Accepted Content-Types

oneOf.title: Single Content-Type
oneOf.description: Accept single content type. json: application/json, form: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

oneOf.title: Multiple Content-Types
oneOf.description: Accept multiple content types

accepts.description: Accepted Content-Types for request body. json: application/json, form: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Returns 415 if not matched.

preTransform.title: Pre-Transform
preTransform.description: JavaScript to validate/transform input before SQL/mock execution. Receives: input (param), ctx (free var, shared state), sql (free var, modifiable). Must return: object with parameters for SQL/mock.

postTransformOne.title: Post-Transform (type: one)
postTransformOne.description: JavaScript to transform single row result. Receives: input (param, original request), output (param, query result), ctx (free var, shared state). Must return: transformed output.
examples: return { id: output.id, fullName: output.first_name + ' ' + output.last_name, processingTime: Date.now() - ctx.startTime };

postTransformMany.title: Post-Transform (type: many)

oneOf.title: Transform All (string shorthand)
oneOf.description: JavaScript to transform entire array. Receives: input, output (params), ctx (free var). Returns: transformed output.

oneOf.title: Transform Each/All (object)

each.title: Transform Each Row
each.description: JavaScript to transform each row individually. Receives: input, output (params, output is current row), ctx (free var). Returns: transformed row.

all.title: Transform All Rows
all.description: JavaScript to transform entire array after each transform. Receives: input, output (params, output is array), ctx (free var). Returns: transformed output.
examples: return { data: output, meta: { count: output.length, limit: ctx.limit } };

oneOf.description: Object with each (per-row transform) and/or all (array transform). If both specified, each runs first.

postTransformMany.description: JavaScript to transform array results. Can be string (transform all) or object with each/all.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: JavaScript to filter array data rows. Receives: row (param, current row), input (param, request parameters), ctx (free var, shared state). Must return: boolean (true to include row).

mockOneObject.title: Mock Object Sources (type: one)

oneOf.title: YAML Object
oneOf.description: Return inline YAML object

oneOf.title: JSON String (object)

object_json.title: JSON Object String
object_json.description: JSON string containing a single object

oneOf.description: Return object parsed from JSON string

oneOf.title: JSON File (object)

object_json_file.title: JSON File Path
object_json_file.description: Path to JSON file containing a single object (relative to config file)

oneOf.description: Return object loaded from JSON file

oneOf.title: JavaScript (object)

object_js.title: JavaScript Object Generator
object_js.description: JavaScript code that returns an object. Receives: input (param), ctx (free var), sql (free var). Return null for 404.
examples:
if (input.id === '404') return null;
return { id: parseInt(input.id), name: 'Mock User' };

oneOf.description: Return object generated by JavaScript

mockOneObject.description: Mock data source returning single object for type: one queries/mutations

mockOneArray.title: Mock Array Sources with Filter (type: one)

oneOf.title: YAML Array with filter
oneOf.description: Filter YAML array to find matching row

oneOf.title: JSON String (array) with filter

array_json.title: JSON Array String
array_json.description: JSON string containing array of objects

oneOf.description: Filter JSON array string to find matching row

oneOf.title: JSON File (array) with filter

array_json_file.title: JSON Array File Path
array_json_file.description: Path to JSON file containing array of objects

oneOf.description: Filter JSON file array to find matching row

oneOf.title: CSV with filter

csv.title: Inline CSV Data
csv.description: Inline CSV data with header row. First line is column names.

oneOf.description: Filter CSV data to find matching row

oneOf.title: CSV File with filter

csv_file.title: CSV File Path
csv_file.description: Path to CSV file (relative to config file)

oneOf.description: Filter CSV file to find matching row

oneOf.title: JSONL with filter

jsonl.title: Inline JSONL Data
jsonl.description: Inline JSONL data (one JSON object per line)

oneOf.description: Filter JSONL data to find matching row

oneOf.title: JSONL File with filter

jsonl_file.title: JSONL File Path
jsonl_file.description: Path to JSONL file (one JSON object per line)

oneOf.description: Filter JSONL file to find matching row

mockOneArray.description: Mock array source with required filter for type: one. Filter selects the first matching row (404 if none match).

mockOne.title: Mock (type: one)
mockOne.description: Mock data source for type: one. Either object sources (return single object) or array sources with filter (select matching row).

mockMany.title: Mock (type: many)

oneOf.title: YAML Array
oneOf.description: Return YAML array (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: JSON String (array)

array_json.title: JSON Array String
array_json.description: JSON string containing array of objects

oneOf.description: Return array parsed from JSON string (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: JSON File (array)

array_json_file.title: JSON Array File Path
array_json_file.description: Path to JSON file containing array of objects

oneOf.description: Return array loaded from JSON file (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: JavaScript (array)

array_js.title: JavaScript Array Generator
array_js.description: JavaScript code that returns an array. Receives: input (param), ctx (free var), sql (free var).
examples:
const count = parseInt(input.count) || 5;
return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: 'User ' + (i + 1) }));

oneOf.description: Return array generated by JavaScript

oneOf.title: CSV

csv.title: Inline CSV Data
csv.description: Inline CSV data with header row

oneOf.description: Return array parsed from CSV data (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: CSV File
oneOf.description: Return array loaded from CSV file (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: JSONL

jsonl.title: Inline JSONL Data
jsonl.description: Inline JSONL data (one JSON object per line)

oneOf.description: Return array parsed from JSONL data (optionally filtered)

oneOf.title: JSONL File
oneOf.description: Return array loaded from JSONL file (optionally filtered)

mockMany.description: Mock data source for type: many. Returns array of objects. Filter is optional.

transformOne.title: Transform (type: one)
transformOne.description: Transform configuration for type: one queries/mutations. Pre runs before SQL/mock, post transforms the result.

transformMany.title: Transform (type: many)
transformMany.description: Transform configuration for type: many queries/mutations. Pre runs before SQL/mock, post transforms the results.

transformNone.title: Transform (type: none)
transformNone.description: Transform configuration for type: none mutations. Only pre-transform is available (no return value to transform).

handleNotFound.title: Handle Not Found
handleNotFound.description: If true, pass null to post-transform instead of returning 404 when no row found. Allows custom not-found handling.

queryOne.title: Query (type: one)

type.title: Query Type
type.description: Single row query. Returns object if found, 404 if not found.

queryOne.description: Query endpoint returning single row. Use sql OR mock (not both).

queryMany.title: Query (type: many)

type.title: Query Type
type.description: Multiple rows query. Returns array (empty array if no rows).

queryMany.description: Query endpoint returning multiple rows. Use sql OR mock (not both).

mutationOne.title: Mutation (type: one)

type.title: Mutation Type
type.description: Mutation returning single row. Use RETURNING * in SQL.

mutationOne.description: Mutation endpoint returning single row. Use sql OR mock (not both).

mutationMany.title: Mutation (type: many)

type.title: Mutation Type
type.description: Mutation returning multiple rows. Use RETURNING * in SQL.

mutationMany.description: Mutation endpoint returning multiple rows. Use sql OR mock (not both).

mutationNone.title: Mutation (type: none)

type.title: Mutation Type
type.description: Mutation with no return value. Returns 204 No Content.

mutationNone.description: Mutation endpoint with no return value (204 No Content). Requires sql (mock not supported).
